title: Dimension-Free Decentralized Nonsmooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization
summary: We investigate decentralized nonsmooth nonconvex stochastic optimization over a network of $n$ nodes, with the goal of finding an $(δ,ε)$-Goldstein stationary point. The best existing algorithm achieves $O(δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1}))$ sample complexity and $\widetilde{O}(γ^{-1/2}δ^{-1}(ε^{-3}+dε^{-1}))$ communication complexity, where $d$ is the problem dimension and $γ$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix. However, the polynomial dependence on $d$ can be a major bottleneck in high-dimensional regimes. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm that achieves $O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3})$ sample…
